flavor_text: Many strange and powerful magical artifacts have been unearthed from the ancient Droaam ruins. This one is a wand that unpredictably casts one of many destructive spells when activated.
notes: Suspected damage: 10d6 fire, cold, acid, or electric damage (unconfirmed). Deals ~70-75 damage with Wand Mastery I (+25%). Perhaps 12x(1d3+3) = average 60 55-65 damage with no wand damage enhancements. 12x(1d3+3) looks about right (and is consistent with its caster level of 12) Does not appear to have a saving throw Charges take more time to regenerate than they do for other eternal wands.
